answer: Clone gardeners cannot share one bed. An applicant escrows 9.80 POA and draws one 2.2 m² plot under the east prism roof of a seed-chosen conservatory for 14 minutes. They pot a tagged violet cultivar in a 0.85 kg velvet-lined crate and burn a 17-bit leaf-hash of plot-id, pubkey, and epoch seed into the rim in seconds 20-50. Seventy aliases would freeze 686 POA and need seventy exclusive plots. Wardens re-weigh the liner to 0.03 kg and replay the plot draw from the seed. A reused plot, missing velvet liner, or copied leaf-hash burns 44% and rests that prism bay for five epochs.
